summary: colinlyguo 提交并合并 EIP-8151 修改，把 EIP-3607 的账户代码限制扩展到 `ecRecover`，同时保留 EIP-7702 委托例外，在账户迁移到代码控制授权（包括后量子方案）后保护不可变合约。nero_eth 表示 Hegotá 将让隐私应用成为以太坊一等公民，去掉可信中继，并为部分状态节点和后量子做准备。mikeneuder 与 maryam 在 ethresear.ch 分析专有 AMM。ACDT #89 与 RPC Standards #31 当晚召开。

items.title: EIP-8151：按账户代码限制 ecRecover
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交并合并：把 EIP-3607 的账户代码限制应用到 `ecRecover`，保留 EIP-7702 委托例外；与 EIP-7851、EIP-8298 等账户迁移路径配合，在账户转向代码控制授权（包括后量子方案）后，协议层的 ECDSA 限制延伸到 `ecRecover`，保护不可变合约。
items.title_en: EIP-8151: restrict ecRecover by account code
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted and merged: applies EIP-3607's account code restriction to `ecRecover` while preserving the EIP-7702 delegation exception. It complements account migration paths such as EIP-7851 and EIP-8298 by extending protocol-level ECDSA restrictions to `ecRecover`, protecting immutable contracts when accounts move to code-controlled authorization, including post-quantum schemes.

items.title_en: Nethermind: the design behind Stellar Private Payments
items.note_en: 19:39: compliance is enforced by the protocol, and the key choice is that association sets attach to user identities rather than deposits, which enables KYC gating and account-level freezes.
